explanation: Requested point (W=1.05 GeV, Q2=0.3 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, phi*=90 deg) is physically impossible for the pion channel (e p -> e' n pi+). The reaction threshold is W_threshold = 1.0791 GeV; at W=1.05 GeV there is insufficient invariant mass to produce the neutron + pi+ final state, so no cross section exists to compute. Independently, the MAID07 lookup table used by this build only covers W in [1.08, 2.00] GeV, so even a numerical run would silently extrapolate the hadronic model below its validated range. This is a physics violation, not a formatting/rounding issue, so no correction (e.g. nudging W upward) was applied automatically -- the preflight check explicitly warns against compensating for unphysical kinematics this way. No EXCLURAD input file was generated. To proceed, the user must supply a W >= 1.0791 GeV (practically W >= 1.09 GeV to stay safely inside the table grid and away from threshold-singular behavior).
